fixture_meta.review_focus: Chris Gier recall pulls trusted memory facts into empty address-book fields without touching blocked, conflicting, or untrusted facts
review_checklist: Primary recall scenario stays on an existing contact with empty safe fields
Trusted facts map to the correct non-sensitive contact fields
Every blocked category has at least one explicit negative example
Conflict and duplicate cases stay out of silent auto-sync

contract.fixture_meta: Sandbox metadata, scenario anchor, and reviewer walk order for side-by-side worker review
contract.sync_policy: Allowed target fields, trusted origins, and blocked categories from SPEC 10
contract.primary_recall_scenario: Main reconciliation case: empty safe fields plus confirmed memory facts
contract.field_classification_examples: Trusted facts that sync into non-obvious contact fields
contract.blocked_auto_sync_examples: Sensitive facts that must never auto-sync into the address book
contract.untrusted_memory_examples: Model-generated facts that must not sync silently
contract.conflict_scenario: Memory value that disagrees with an existing address-book field
contract.duplicate_preservation_scenario: Trusted fact that already exists and must not create a duplicate

primary_recall_scenario.short_label: Happy path: fill empty safe fields from trusted memory
primary_recall_scenario.narrative: Chris Gier already exists in the address book, but preference fields are empty while trusted memory facts are available.
primary_recall_scenario.user_prompt: Was weisst du ueber Chris Gier?
reconciliation_steps: User asks a recall question for an existing contact.
System finds confirmed memory facts for Chris Gier.
Trusted low-risk facts populate the matching empty address-book fields.
Blocked, conflicting, and untrusted facts stay out of the address book.

field_classification_examples.rationale: Dietary forms belong in personal details, not generic preferences.
Explicit hobbies belong in the hobbies field.
Explicit dislikes belong in the dislikes field.

field_classification_examples.fact: Chris Gier verbringt gern Zeit im Garten
field_classification_examples.rationale: Longer hobby phrases stay intact instead of being split into single words.

Chris Gier ist mit Anna verheiratet
Chris Gier verdient 120000 Euro im Jahr

untrusted_memory_examples.rationale: Model-generated facts must not silently sync even when they look plausible.

conflict_scenario.rationale: Conflicting memory and address-book values must not be overwritten silently.

duplicate_preservation_scenario.short_label: Trusted fact already stored in address book
duplicate_preservation_scenario.rationale: An already stored safe fact must not create a duplicate entry.

notes: Synthetic shadow data for worker side-by-side comparison
Not wired to Janus memory, contacts, or orchestration
The hobby fact text also appears in untrusted_memory_examples to show origin-based blocking
Conflict and duplicate scenarios document negative sync paths without changing product code
short_label fields are reviewer hints only and do not change executable fixture semantics
